Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that balanced forces explain the onset of motion and chose option A. Balanced forces cannot cause acceleration; the object begins to slide when an applied force exceeds static friction, creating a net (unbalanced) force. The correct choice is B.
